title: feed.rollback_received
description: A settlement of these markets was withdrawn (C05 §7): they are unsettled (suspended) until a new settlement arrives. Published by the feed service on NATS subject evt.feed.rollback_received (version 1); C10 reverses the bets it settled with the withdrawn result (B7). This is the `data` payload; the envelope (event_id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, trace_id) is TD-02 §5. Feed events are global: the envelope's tenant_id is null (B4a plan, decision 5). New fields are additive only.

fixture_id.description: Catalogue fixture ID (opaque; contract fixtures keep the contract's IDs, e.g. fx_arsenal_chelsea)

ts_ms.description: The provider's timestamp of the message, Unix milliseconds; changes apply in this order (FEED-07)
